text:
deploy-bot: Deploy job dpl-4821 started for rollout rwinf-1.14.2 -> regions [US, EU, APAC]. Canary: US 5% for 10m. Change window 2026-03-18 23:00-02:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.infer/release/1.14.2

sanjay: Canary started in us-west. Initial 10m health checks passing — latency p50 68ms, p95 210ms. No errors so far.

lucy: Quick capacity peek in eu-west: node pools at 78% GPU mem, 84% CPU. If we shift full 33% traffic, that's going to be tight. Recommend pre-warming one extra pool (pool-prewarm-eu-2).

ops-bot: autoscaler: prewarm requested -> pool-prewarm-eu-2 provisioning, ETA ~3m. (event id: asc-9812)

marie: FYI there was a tiny spike in decode errors on 1.14.2 in our QA run earlier (~0.8% on long sequences). Agree with prewarm and suggest we PIN EU to 1.14.1 for the first full shift until metrics stabilize.

alice: Proposal: finish US rollout if canary stays healthy, then pin EU to 1.14.1 for 30m observation window, APAC remains on HOLD until EU is cleared. @sanjay ok?

sanjay: OK. I'll let US canary finish its 10m. If stable at +20m we promote US to full. For EU pinning: run `route pin eu=* rwinf-1.14.1` (ops has automation).

deploy-bot: Received action: PAUSE_APAC. Applying EU pin as requested. Rollout paused for APAC.

eng-release: Runbook reminder: after each regional shift run these smoke checks: text-gen short, chat-stream start->end, embeddings sanity. Quick command:```sh
./infra/tools/smoke.sh --region eu-west --brief
``` Sample expected: `OK, text-gen p95 < 400ms, error_rate < 0.5%`

ops-bot: smoke results US canary: PASS. p95 latency moved 220ms -> 225ms (within SLO). No elevated error rate.

lucy: Prewarm completed in 2m, pool-prewarm-eu-2 is green and registered.

marie: EU pin applied. Starting slow shift to EU at 10% now for 15m observation.

ops-bot: EU shift 10% started. Monitoring: async queue depth +12% vs baseline. Keeping eye on CPU/GPU steal.

sanjay: Note: if queue depth > 30% or p95 jumps > 40% we trigger rollback to 1.14.1 (auto-rule).

ops-bot: ALERT: EU queue depth reached 36% (asc-ev: queue-spike-322). Triggering rollback to rwinf-1.14.1 for eu-* per policy.

alice: Rolling back EU was the right call. We'll keep APAC on hold. Need to collect logs and correlate batch sizes.

marie: Opening quick issue: "decode/batching regression observed in 1.14.2 during EU slow shift" and adding a note to release notes for follow-up. @lucy can you run kernel/quant checks tomorrow?

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for EU. EU now pinned to rwinf-1.14.1. APAC remains PAUSED. Job dpl-4821 status: US=rolled, EU=rolled-back->pinned, APAC=paused.

sanjay: After kernel tweak + QA, propose a v1.14.2-hotfix canary in next maintenance window. I'll schedule a follow-up.

alice: Agreed. Closing this rollout for now; will re-schedule APAC after fixes. Thanks all :heart:
